verdict.rationale: Ubuntu explicitly claims certification on Raspberry Pi with a 'rich developer experience' and broader docs describe strong IDE/AI-ML tooling support, but there is no independent or hands-on evidence validating performance, package availability, or workflow parity on low-cost SBCs specifically. missing for 10: hands-on/independent corroboration of SBC dev experience, benchmarks or details on which IDEs/tools work well on Arm SBCs, coverage of other low-cost boards beyond Raspberry Pi.
